name: Southern Utah University
notes: Scope: three unambiguous resident automatic first-year tiers. Founders omitted: admissions and renewal amounts conflict. President's is competitive. Nonresident and transfer tables are not drafted. COA is unknown; tuition is not used as COA.
review_issues: Resolve the Founders discrepancy before claiming full resident-table coverage.
Review award-specific renewal and age conditions at https://www.suu.edu/finaid/scholarshipguidelines.html.
Confirm the number of award-bearing semesters per academic year before any annual cost conversion; it is currently unknown.

research.policy_note: Bounded manual public-page review. Robots does not disallow this scholarship path. Only public facts and paraphrases retained; no logos, screenshots or copied page prose. General terms, where not located, remain an owner review item.

tiers.gpa_basis_note: Unweighted cumulative high-school GPA. GPA OR ACT OR SAT pathways; a test-based award also needs high-school GPA 2.3. No superscores.
tiers.renewal_conditions: Eight-semester renewable award. Full-time enrollment, completion rate and award-specific SUU GPA requirements apply; compare the official renewal table and award agreement.
tiers.requires_action: Complete admission before March 1 for fall or November 1 for spring. Attend SUU Main Campus; the source identifies Fall 2027 awards.

rules.note: Confirm traditional-age and Main Campus eligibility under SUU academic scholarship guidelines.
